test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Shagun, Pragya, Yati, Lovey, Savi and Frooti are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Shagun sits 2nd to the left of Pragya. Yati sits 2nd to the left of Shagun. Lovey sits 3rd to the left of Yati. Savi sits 2nd to the left of Lovey.

Who sits 3rd to the left of Shagun?
solution:
Given : Shagun, Pragya, Yati, Lovey, Savi and Frooti are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

Explanation :

1) Shagun sits 2nd to the left of Pragya.

2) Yati sits 2nd to the left of Shagun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44e5f5f4705f80d5f69155bfa8ba6d7acddcd060586e03c656ed5a8ba52552d9.png] 

3) Lovey sits 3rd to the left of Yati.

4) Savi sits 2nd to the left of Lovey.

After positioning Lovely and Savi only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Frooti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb4b5f623aa9cf802f8b1893554ca3df26cb36bf24d6ec81675b90d213a430f5.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Frooti sits 3rd to the left of Shagun.

Hence, "Frooti" is the correct answer.
